en.html: Still, I've seen it in progress. I can't imagine it's changed all that dramatically since then.

ja.text: それでも、草薙健一郎をして天才と言わしめた、御桜稟の完成画に、俺は心の奥底で何か期待していた。
ja.html: それでも、草薙健一郎をして天才と言わしめた、御桜稟の完成画に、俺は心の奥底で何か期待していた。

en.text: Even so, deep down, I find myself expecting something from Rin Misakura's finished painting. Even Kenichirou Kusanagi called her a genius.
en.html: Even so, deep down, I find myself expecting something from Rin Misakura's finished painting. Even Kenichirou Kusanagi called her a genius.
